data.long_meaning: In Persian culture, Parna is derived from the name of the lotus flower. It is a symbol of beauty, purity, and rebirth. The lotus flower blooms in muddy water, rising above it to reveal its beautiful petals. Similarly, a child named Parna is believed to possess the qualities of strength, resilience, and grace, rising above any challenges they may face.

A child named Parna is believed to carry the energy of this tree, embodying its spiritual qualities and sharing its blessings with the world.
